name: leohoudinisanders-byte/forensics-mcp
description: On-chain Forensics: x402-payable MCP tools for AI agents. Token verdict cards ($0.02), pre-trade settle-safe screens for tokenized equities and RWAs ($0.02), wallet trust screens ($0.05), ERC-20 forensics profiles ($0.05), and composed due-diligence memos ($0.25+). Base, Ethereum, and XRPL. Payment per tool call via x402 (USDC on Base, EIP-3009): a paid tools/call returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED until the client signs and retries with X-PAYMENT. The forensics_info tool is free. Payments settle to the operator wallet; no API keys, no signup.
